integrity: The published piecewise James profile was inspected in full and is used as a cited premise. The new optimization and affine-regular identification are proved explicitly and checked by an exact Q(sqrt(5)) verifier. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The optimization is restricted to Mizuguchi's one-parameter family of decagonal Radon planes. It does not classify all Radon planes or all decagonal norms. The comparison with the separate Banach--Mazur result is only a numerical equality of exact values; no general identity between the invariants is asserted.
title: The affine-regular decagon uniquely minimizes the James constant in a decagonal Radon family
